title: Prominence on 30A Sugar Magnolia Prominence on 30a
meta_description: Prominence 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Sugar Magnolia, located in Watersound, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home with gulf & pool view and is complete with all of the conveniences of home. 6 Seater Golf cart and 4 bikes included with your stay.
description_expanded: Description Description Prominence 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Sugar Magnolia, located in Watersound, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home with gulf & pool view and is complete with all of the conveniences of home. 6 Seater Golf cart and 4 bikes included with your stay. Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! LEARN MORE ABOUT THE PROMINENCE ON 30A NEIGHBORHOOD One of the only homes in Prominence that enjoys views of the Gulf of Mexico and the South neighborhood resort-style pool. Public beach access is an easy bike ride or golf cart ride away. Guests will enjoy all the amenities of the Prominence community and will appreciate the close proximity to the town center, where they can experience all The Big Chill has to offer. Just minutes away on foot to great shopping, dining and fun for the entire family! Public beach access is an easy golf cart ride, bike ride or walk away. You’ll enjoy all the comforts of home in this elegant comfortable family friendly home filled with coastal charm! Upon arrival, you’ll notice the over-sized driveway with ample parking, room for 6-seater golf cart (included) and bike parking. As you step into Sugar Magnolia, guests will take note of the open environment with 10-foot ceilings and coastal style throughout the home, including a first floor master suite with private access to the back patio. The dining table can seat 10 andthere are 4 extra seats at the kitchen island. In the back of the home you will find a covered deck with sectional and an expanded paver patio with outdoorteak dining table for 8, plus a Weber grill! Head up to the 2nd floor and you will find spacious living quarters, including 3 additional full bathrooms, a 2nd master (w/ en suite), 3rd kingbedroom, bunkroom with two sets of T/T bunks, private office w/additional sleeping, and 2nd floor balcony with gulf view. Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES * 30A 4 Bedroom Beach House with GULF VIEW * 6-SEATER GOLF CART INCLUDED * PET FRIENDLY*** * 2600+ square feet * 2 Master Suites (One on the Main & Upstairs) * 3 patios, one w/ a view of the Gulf, one with a Pool View * Front Porch Swing w/Gulf of Mexico view * Large Living Area w/75" TV plus DVD Player * Fully Equipped Kitchen w/Breakfast Bar * 1st Floor Master Suite w/King Bed, 55" TV * Master Bathroom Features an Extra Large Shower * 2nd Floor Master Suite w/King Bed, 50" TV * 2nd Master Bathroom Features an Extra Large Shower * 3rd Bedroom w/King Bed, 50" TV * 4th Bedroom w/2 Custom Built Bunk Beds (T/T, T/T), 50" TV* * Hotel Quality Mattresses in all bedrooms * Office/Study w/Daybed (T/T Trundle), 50" TV * Queen Sleeper in Living Area * Full Size Washer/Dryer * Weber Grill on back patio * 8-seater teak outdoor dining table on paved patio, excellent for outdoor dining * Parking - 4 Cars plus the Golf Cart Included w/Stay * House Located on the Beach Side of 30A * Games and movies included for family fun! * Easy Public Beach Access * Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi * Sleeps 14 Note: Surveillance device/s located on exterior of home 30A Beach Access Points Please note that Beach Access for ALL Prominence homes are via Public beach access points. Prominence homes do NOT have direct beach access via Watersound Club nor do they have access to private club facilities. PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONS*** We welcome well trained non-shedding dogs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. ADDITIONAL PET FEE APPLIES & IS COLLECTED AFTER BOOKING IS MADE. This includes emotional support animals. About Prominence on 30A - Watersound, FloridaProminence is one of the most popular communities on 30A and features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Prominence is perfectly located to new and long time 30A haunts as well as the beautiful white beaches of Scenic 30A. Guests will enjoy a beautiful town center and 2 resort style pools.Located at the town center, the Big Chill is a hot-spot for entertainment and features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for sporting events and movie nights on the green. Concerts, family activities, restaurants, and boutique shops are just some of the things to do within a less than 5 minute walk. Prominence is centrally located on 30A between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys and Rosemary Beach to the east.COMMUNITY and THE BIG CHILL AMENITIESWalking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly EntertainmentCigar and Gastro Pub - Luke Bryan's Place & Popular HangoutOnsite Ice MachineKids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub2 Large Community Pools; Zero Entry (no steps) – perfect for the elderly and toddlersBarbecue AreasProximity to the amenities at Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seaside5 miles to nearest Grocery Store***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct)Please note: Pool heated seasonally is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any change in seasonal heating of the one pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to pool heated seasonally.Beach Accesses for ALL Prominence homes are via South Walton public beach access points. Most Prominence guests utilize Deer Lake State Park beach access or other nearby public beach accesses. Prominence homes do not have direct beach access via Watersound Club nor do they have access to Watersound private club facilities.INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read less
